profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Building a next-generation machine learning ultracluster powered by NVIDIA GPUs and the AWS EC2 Nitro system.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
AWS EC2 Nitro - Virtualization team
Provides legacy device emulation, Instance Meta-data Service (IMDS) and DNS to the guest instance.
Drives instance migration without customer impaction to handle oversubscription and host maintenance
Drives critical system interactions within the Nitro Hypervisor and across EC2 control-plane services.

positions.title: Firmware Engineer
positions.description:
SanDisk Client SSD FTL/FIL team

▪ Developed software features for mass production memory device
- 5 shipping projects and more: WD Black/Blue NVMe/SATA SSD, SSD for Microsoft Xbox
- Hands-on experience in shipping quality software design/implementation/testing/validation/integration
- Hands-on experience on software development process (source control, code review, coding standard)
- Strong problem solving, debugging, trouble shooting skills. Quick learner.
▪ FTL (Flash Transition Layer)
- Worked with cross functional team to design/develop power-state based drive background
maintenance operation to ensure full performance & data reliability in active time.
- Worked on performance critical path to reduce read latency given current software architectures
limitation and came up with alternative solution to meet customer’s hard requirement.
- Worked on exception handling for PLP(Power-Loss-Protection) to maximize data
integrity/reliability and stabilize initialization process.
- Worked with test/validation team to increase test coverage for corner case scenarios and helped
identifying problems in advance for software reliability.
- Worked on garbage collection source selection algorithm optimization to increase efficiency
▪ FIL (Flash Interface Layer)
- Quickly learned & improved existing data recovery feature(XOR) to enhance user data reliability.
- Introduced new TLC direct write feature to increase write performance and space efficiency.

positions.title: Firmware Intern
positions.description:
Western Digital HDD Servo team

▪ Developed software feature enhancing servo stability
- Worked on preventive method for head collision using signal processing in piezoelectric sensor data
- Developed multi-frequency error injection feature for servo stability testing.
- Developed MATLAB visualization tool measuring linear regression model on servo circuit calibration

positions.title: Graduate Student Researcher
positions.locationName: UCLA Embedded and Reconfigurable Systems Lab
positions.description:
Developed Portable health monitoring device (by Arduino & C++)
▪ Build a prototype device with WiFi, Bluetooth, GPS, IMU, LCD
▪ Developed device/module initialization code
